title: On the Convergence of Multicalibration Gradient Boosting
abstract: arXiv:2602.06773v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multicalibration gradient boosting has recently emerged as a scalable method that empirically produces approximately multicalibrated predictors and has been deployed at web scale. Despite this empirical success, its convergence properties are not well understood. In this paper, we provide computational guarantees for multicalibration gradient boosting algorithms. We show that the magnitude of successive prediction updates decays at $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ (in the minimum over $T$ rounds), which implies the same convergence rate bound for the empirical multicalibration error over rounds. For the squared-error loss, this rate improves to linear convergence under additional smoothness assumptions on the weak learners, and convergence extends to relaxed and adaptive rescaling variants. Combining the empirical bound with uniform convergence arguments, we also bound the population multicalibration error for the log-loss under additional conditions

translated_title: 论多校准梯度提升的收敛性
translated_abstract: 多校准梯度提升近来作为一种可扩展的方法出现，它能够在实证上产生近似多校准的预测器，并已在网络规模的系统中部署应用。尽管取得了这一实证成功，但其收敛性质尚未得到充分理解。本文为多校准梯度提升算法提供了计算保证。我们证明连续预测更新的幅度以 $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ 的速率衰减（在 $T$ 轮上取最小值），这意味着逐轮的经验多校准误差也具有相同的收敛速率界。对于平方误差损失，在对弱学习器附加平滑性假设的条件下，该速率可提升至线性收敛，且收敛结论可扩展到松弛版本和自适应重缩放变体。将该经验界与一致收敛论证相结合，我们还在附加条件下对对数损失给出了总体多校准误差的界。
tldr: 本文首次为多校准梯度提升算法提供了理论收敛保证，证明预测更新以 O(1/√T) 的速率衰减，并在平方误差损失及弱学习器平滑性假设下进一步提升至线性收敛。
